notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Since the Demo released I've received feedback and played the game a lot. 
The following is a list of improvements made from release up to the current version.

Gameplay changes

 A skippable video tutorial plays as the level loads
 A Machine Gun has replaced the single shot rifle as the starter weapon
 Opening the menu now pauses the game
 Opening the inventory slows down time by 60%
 Mob waves and weapon damage rebalanced
 Highscore added to end-screen
 Dropped items are easier to see and when the mouse hovers over them, a name plate is shown
 Toggle showing all nearby name plates by pressing ALT
 Terrain gets in your way a lot less frequently
 Health damage is now more noticeable when health is low
 Quickly transfer items from inventory to equipment or the reverse using shift + double click
 UI Audio improved
 Item icons are more distinct and readable
 The camera can now move both closer and further away from the action
 Rear vehicle light added to help with orientation
 Vehicle handling changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119535/43394f2430b39797e1776e50e03a77e9f96574f1.jpg

Bug Fixes

 Weapons used to sometimes keep firing after reloading
 Inventory drag and drop now functioning properly
 Low health effects no longer scale with max health
 Restart Map button now works properly
 It's now possible to hit small mobs even when they are very close to the vehicle
 Fixed a crash to desktop related to looting invalid nearby items
 Music no longer stops playing randomly
 Tons of small bug fixes and tweaks
Optimizations

 Reduced package size from ~14 GB to ~6 GB
 Map loading reworked to reduce loading times and RAM demands

Coming to the demo
In a not too distant future

 Controller support
 A new level
 Weapon, mob and wave rebalancing
 New guns and vehicles
 Speed boosts
 Dynamic music
 Greater enemy variation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119535/7e83c94c19219f1758180b3c116cff94b206ae38.jpg

Big thanks for playing and a special thanks to the players that provide feedback and bug reports!
/Sven

notes.title: DEMO AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
The Wire Throne Demo is now available! 

Provide entertainment for your AI overlords as you battle for survival in the bloodsports arena. 

In this singleplayer demo you will face off against surplus robotic-machinery, failed cybernetic experiments, drones, other vehicles and remote controlled Neuron-Link customers.

To survive all 30 waves you will need to scavenge your fallen enemies for gear upgrades and items.
Try to survive the final waves by scavenging the environment and your fallen foes for upgrades and scraps.
